## From code to logic

Connect Python conditions to Boolean expressions, truth tables, and logic gates.

## From diagram to circuit

Take a logic requirement, draw the gate diagram, build it in Tinkercad Circuits, and test every input combination.

## Use meaningful systems

Examples can include starter interlocks, warning lamps, cooling-fan requests, or machine safety logic so the Boolean expression represents an actual technical decision.
